title: Warm Bread in the Morning
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Long ago in Jerusalem
The people cried and cried;
Their homes were gone, their hearts were stones,
They felt so sad inside.

[Chorus]
His kindness comes back fresh and new
With every rising sun,
Like warm bread in the morning light
For every little one.

[Verse 2]
The writer sat and thought a while
And then began to say:
"The Lord's compassions never fail,
They're new with every day."

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Wren spilled her juice at breakfast time
And felt bad all day long;
But Mom said, "Tomorrow's brand-new,"
So Wren sang out this song.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So when the sun comes peeking up
And paints the sky with gold,
Remember kindness waits for you,
Brand-new and never old.

[Chorus]
mood: Waking-up music. A gentle lift under the voice, like a kitchen window going from grey to gold while bread warms in the oven. A small harp plucking a light, even pattern, one cello note held warm underneath. It begins pale and soft and brightens a little with every verse, open and warm by the last chorus, never loud.
